title: Wendell and the Sigil Again
author: Cyrus Okafor
blurb: Mara Lockridge, a hedge-witch's runaway apprentice, has spent ten years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
